title: Black Bob Elementary keychain
subtitle: Traced from the school logo · 60 mm across the ring · style A layered heights · 4 colours (red, white, black, grey visor) · shown hanging · millimetres
scale_note: Real size: 60 mm across the red ring (your pick: 55-60). The tab adds 8 mm on top. Type 55 in the real-size box to preview the smaller option.
notes_title: v3: back to the logo’s shapes
notes: v3: the beak and cap are traced from the logo again, not redrawn, so they keep the logo's shapes: slim beak lines, the hooked tip, the lower jaw. The trace is now sub-pixel (it uses the logo's anti-aliasing), so edges are smooth without reshaping anything. The black lines are only slightly thickened (Bambu Studio's Arachne prints thin lines). The "BB" is a font fitted to the logo's own BB (its size, tilt and spot). The visor is grey, as in the logo, which needs a 4th AMS slot. Ring letters are still the fitted font from v2. Check: the beak, the cap and BB, and the eye area.
